finding: Timed opening cards (startup book, title and quote at 5 s, story 13/13/10 s; New Game nine 5 s cards) with skip on any input, then six creation screens and a dream cinematic before control. Level-up ceremony waits for a clear area, plays a fanfare, then applies health. Exit from the start dungeon drops the player in a random location of the race's home province. Gaps: first fight, town and start map content are not in the box; the Generate class button is an empty handler (todo).

Opening movies (logo, intro, credits, elder) gated by a skip flag; premade or custom character at the selector. Core rule: on each world step a chance roll picks an encounter, then a separate outdoorsman roll decides whether it is spotted (yes or no prompt, plus XP of 100 minus the skill) or walks in unwarned. Licence is SUL, so clean-room, shape only; first map, first fight and town are in the data pack, not in the box.
